parent_objective: choose a next source-mining path after M1220 finds hidden-path sensitivity but no real matched-history action signal
blocked_by: M1220 shows reset/random/scaled hidden perturbations move action but wrong/delayed current-family matched histories remain action-equivalent
supersedes: directly running outcome interventions from M1217 rows
directly changing PPO or hidden objectives without an action-critical source
invalidates: treating off-manifold hidden perturbation sensitivity as causal-history evidence

public_gates: M1221 may inspect source-mining tools and existing artifacts only
M1221 must select an action-critical mining route before any outcome gate
M1221 must preserve the P0 human-view no-wheel actor contract
M1221 must not run outcome interventions
M1221 must not use private holdout
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run outcome intervention gates
do not use hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not treat random/reset/scaled hidden sensitivity as self-identification
do not continue from M1217 rows unless a real-history action-critical screen is expected

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: selects a source-mining route that can produce source-diverse matched-current pairs with real-history action divergence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process/design route only; no closed-loop, training, promotion, private-holdout, paper-level, recurrent-belief, or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if no existing tool can produce candidate action-critical real-history pairs
stop if proposed route relies on private holdout or hidden/oracle actor inputs
stop if branch cadence requires synthesis before another narrow implementation milestone
fallback_plan: design a minimal selector if existing tools cannot use M1217/M1220 artifacts
pivot to stronger cross-family or adversarial history sources if current-family histories remain too close
write branch synthesis if another action-screen negative closes the current causal-history source path
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1220 blocks outcome rollout and selects action-critical hidden-history source mining

training_stage.stage_objective: select action-critical hidden-history source mining route
admission_evidence: M1220 random_hidden_unit reset_hidden and scaled_hidden variants move action strongly
M1220 wrong_matched_history delayed_history and shuffled_history are weak or sparse
M1220 blocks outcome rollout from M1217 rows
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: one concrete action-critical mining command or implementation route is selected
admission thresholds for a future action screen are specified

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1221 is only a source selection design and must not infer history necessity from hidden-path structural sensitivity.
history_necessity_tests: tooling readiness for real-history action-critical pair mining
source-diversity requirements for wrong/delayed/shuffled history action screens
controls preventing off-manifold hidden perturbations from becoming self-ID evidence
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: A future M1222-style mining run may produce an admission surface; outcome evidence remains blocked until action-critical real-history rows exist.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If no action-critical real-history source is available, record the branch as blocked or pivot to stronger source generation instead of running outcome gates.
allowed_claims: no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: Existing action-critical wrong-history mining tools can be routed to produce a better real-history action-screen source than the M1217 current-family matched-current surface.
success_criteria: existing tools and their compatible inputs are audited
one next mining route is selected with concrete thresholds
no outcome intervention, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, profile tuning, or actor-input contract expansion occurs
failure_criteria: off-manifold hidden effects are claimed as self-identification
